sentences.text: The car was too fast for Gran.
“That car is too fast,” she said.
The magic took Biff and Chip.
The magic took them to a race.
The children looked at the Baron.
The Baron looked at the children.
The Baron put oil on the road.
The car skidded on the oil.
It crashed through the fence and went down the mountain.
Gran turned on to a bridge.
The Baron's car crashed down into the river.
Gran took the fast car back.
